LAREDO — A 34-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Saturday morning on an alleged felony drug charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Juan Hector Montemayor was arrested on October 24, 2026, at 7:32 a.m. The booking record lists possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 1/1-B, under 1 gram — a state jail felony. Bond was not set.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
